scope: Next twelve unresolved private-nonprofit institutions in the alphabetical L segment
safeguards: Only official institution-owned employee pages or institution-specific ATS tenants were promoted.
Student, alumni, and third-party vacancy services were not treated as employee sources.
Institutions ending normal academic operations were held instead of being promoted as active employers.
A durable vacancy index was required; stale documents and maintenance notices were not sufficient.
